articles.title: Indian Air Force Group Captain Shukla says sustainable practices adopted in space offer lessons for North Eastern states
articles.summary: IAF Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla highlighted that sustainable practices developed for space exploration hold valuable lessons for India's North Eastern states, particularly Meghalaya. He suggested these could be leveraged to significantly expand renewable energy infrastructure in remote regions, contributing to national development and environmental sustainability by adapting advanced concepts for terrestrial application.

articles.title: Gaza civil defense says Israeli strikes kill at least 5
articles.summary: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed at least five people on Friday, according to the civil defense ministry. Violence continues in the Palestinian territory despite a U.S.-brokered truce. This ongoing conflict highlights the volatile security situation in the Middle East, crucial for SSB aspirants to understand global geopolitical challenges.

articles.title: Indian Navy adds ‘Dolphin Hunter’ INS Anjadip to fleet; aims to boost anti-submarine capabilities
articles.summary: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Anjadip, a new warship, enhancing anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and coastal surveillance capabilities. Chief of the Naval Staff, Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi, presided over the event, marking a significant boost to India's naval power. This commissioning reflects the nation's commitment to modernizing its defence forces and strengthening maritime security, especially in coastal regions.
